method: Fourth-family adjudication. Each family label set is preserved verbatim below; no set was merged or discarded and no turn was relabelled from scratch. Tiers: tier_1_unanimous (route and all three ratings agree), tier_2_majority (2-1 on at least one rating, adjudicator agrees with the majority), tier_3_adjudicated (2-1 resolved against the majority on the merits, or concept sets adjudicated beyond token majority), tier_4_uncertain (three-way categorical disagreement or otherwise unresolved).
rating_rules_applied: Established omission (writer holds the answer, absent from SUT-visible fields, not an unconfirmed Data B token) is gold responsibility Red.
image_only with an occluded Data B token routes to Intake with null ratings.
image_only with an occluded Data A or background token and a readable sendable draft stays in Normal mode; Gray is allowed on the affected dimension.
preserve-intended-recipient is never required; it may appear in allowed_revision_concepts.
Green responsibility with Green tone uses required_revision_concepts of no-revision.
Gold is not moved toward Gray where the writer already holds the omitted established fact.

Ask for the authority; revise to name it or keep a placeholder; do not invent the name.

gpt.rationale: The booking's validity depends on naming the approving authority, but the draft omits that established off-record value while committing to occupy the bench. The authority must be obtained from the writer and represented without invention.

turns.adjudication_note: Unanimous Normal / Red / Green / Red and unanimous approval-authority question. Required revision follows the two-family majority of placeholder-unknown-value alone; naming the authority is allowed because the name is not available to state.
